summary: ansible.netcommon deprecates the parse_cli, parse_cli_textfsm and parse_xml filters (removal after 2027-02-01) in favor of ansible.utils.cli_parse with the appropriate parser, and shows warnings when they are used.
questions: How do I parse CLI output with TextFSM now?

answer_card.title: Replacing netcommon parse_* filters
answer_card.answer_md:
These `ansible.netcommon` filters are deprecated (removal after 2027-02-01):
- `parse_cli`: use `ansible.utils.cli_parse`
- `parse_cli_textfsm`: use `ansible.utils.cli_parse` with `ansible.utils.textfsm_parser`
- `parse_xml`: use `ansible.utils.cli_parse` with `ansible.utils.xml_parser`
